t: When you have started but cannot see progress
a: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
p: Wa-lladhīna jāhadū fīnā la-nahdiyannahum subulanā, wa inna-llāha la-maʿa-l-muḥsinīn.
m: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
